prompt: Generate a black and white, monochrome line art owl reading a book, low level of detail such as if suitable for carving. Plain white background. No shading or text.
costNote: The built-in imagegen tool did not report API usage or cost. Separate Sonnet API experiments are recorded in live-generation-metrics.json.

comparison.note: Both original sources run through the production tracer/preparer and CAM checker. This is a qualitative workflow comparison; prompts and models differ, so it is not a controlled model or cost benchmark. Numeric checks do not grade illustration quality.

traceWarnings: Raster tracing converts dark pixels to filled cut regions. Shading, color and anti-aliasing are discarded; compare the original image and traced contours.
Smooth tracing uses 825 cubic curves and 14 lines; 4 filled components and 12 holes remain. Gentle curve joins have aligned tangents; sharp corners and straight edges are retained.
Measured raster contour boundary error is 0.228 mm; coverage overlap 97.46%; enlargement cannot recover image detail. Compare the source and smooth trace.
Removed 0 isolated dark specks (0 tracing pixels) below the physical noise threshold. Small intended marks can also be removed.
Curve-fitting microcorners spanning less than 1 mm are smoothed; original long corners remain pinned.
Near-elliptical contours were fitted as smooth ellipses, including round pupils or counters, and checked against the original pixel coverage.
The 1312 × 1199 pixel source was downsampled to a 1046 × 955 tracing grid. The original image is retained.

warnings: Detail preparation removed 10.79 mm² of cut area, including narrow branches or corners. Compare the artwork before applying.
Approximately 4.63 mm² of narrow remaining gaps or lands need review at the 1 mm threshold. They were not filled automatically.
Contours are simplified within 0.025 mm after physical detail preparation. Smooth-source CAM chord approximation stays within 0.05 mm; detail cleanup is reported separately.
